FN-XDSDSE7-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 472
Committee: Ways and Means General Fund Sponsor: Representative Reed Ingram
Analyst: Cary Dean Date: 04/07/2025
House Bill 472 as introduced would increase the annual obligations of the various state agencies
by an estimated $440,000, cumulatively, as estimated by the Comptrollers Office, by increasing
the meal allowance for certain in-state travel from 15%, under current law, to 17.5% of the
regular per diem rate (currently set by the Governor at $85).

FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 472
Committee: Finance and Taxation General Fund Sponsor: Representative Reed Ingram
Analyst: Cary Dean Date: 04/28/2025
House Bill 472 as passed the House of Representatives would increase the annual obligations of
the various state agencies by an estimated $440,000, cumulatively, as estimated by the State
Comptroller's Office, by increasing the meal allowance for certain in-state travel from 15%,
under current law, to 17.5% of the regular per diem rate (currently set by the Governor at $85).
